featured_reviews.name: Jones JP
featured_reviews.review_text:
Good for eye checkup. One thing - they test eyes by making you look at the chart (Sugra Snellen) kept printed at a distance. Wheras at Lenskart they test by making you look at a display (like a TV screen) which is kept at a shorter distance. Frankly, the first "analog" method used in this shop is much better.

Please note - DO NOT BE HAPPY IF YOU CAN JUST READ. The question is, are the letters clear to you?

The optician seemed experienced, and the lens that I got works well.

Now, regarding the frames, I got more or less exactly what I was looking for in my budget. So, all good there.
